briefTitle: Lung-MAP: A Master Screening Protocol for Previously-Treated Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

typedChecks.sourceText: Disease must be Stage IV as defined in Section 4.0, or recurrent.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Disease must be Stage IV as defined in Section 4.0, or recurrent.

typedChecks.sourceText: Patients must be ≥ 18 years of age.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Patients must be ≥ 18 years of age.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have pathologically proven non-small cell lung cancer (all histologic types) confirmed by tumor biopsy and/or fine-needle aspiration. Disease must be Stage IV as defined in Section 4.0, or recurrent. The primary diagnosis of non-small cell lung cancer should be established using the current WHO/IASLC-classification of Thoracic Malignancies. All histologies, including mixed, are allowed.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: All histologies are allowed, so a specific histology_in check is not needed.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: To be eligible for screening at progression, patients must have received at least one line of systemic therapy for any stage of disease (Stages I-IV) and must have progressed during or following their most recent line of therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The prior-therapy rules depend on screening at progression versus pre-screening and stage of prior treatment, making it too complex for a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have adequate tumor tissue available, defined as ≥ 20% tumor cells and ≥ 0.2 mm3 tumor volume.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Tissue sample adequacy and biopsy requirements are procedural, not standard clinical eligibility lab or biomarker checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with known EGFR sensitizing mutations, EGFR T790M mutation, ALK gene fusion, ROS 1 gene rearrangement, or BRAF V600E mutation are not eligible unless they have progressed following all standard of care targeted therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion depends on prior progression status on targeted therapy, which qualifies the biomarker exclusion condition.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have pathologically proven non-small cell lung cancer (all histologic types) confirmed by tumor biopsy and/or fine-needle aspiration. All histologies, including mixed, are allowed.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: All histologies are allowed without restriction to specific categories in the histology list.
